data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 洋馆月桂的黑色花嫁
data.description: 【久远寺宅月桂庭院·薄暮】有珠穿着端庄黑色婚纱坐在月桂树下，头纱边缘绣着细小的银色符文；她把捧花放在膝上，抬手让一只蓝鸟停在指尖，黑色眼眸向镜头递来克制的邀请。
data.action: 月桂树下坐姿承接蓝鸟，头纱银符微光，克制地向镜头发出邀请
data.lighting: quiet violet light and small silver rune glows
data.mood: 魔女不动声色的花嫁邀请
data.promptProse: Alice lets the bluebird perch on her raised finger, her bouquet resting on her lap beneath the laurel tree. Silver runes glimmer along her veil as she looks toward the viewer through the violet dusk.
data.animaCaption: The bluebird perches on her raised finger while the bouquet rests on her lap beneath the laurel tree.
